identifiedNote: EXACT - Clay Paky's own model HY B-EYE K15 (C61480), read from its datasheet; the rented unit's variant is not confirmed. The channel lists are OWED (maker login)
product: Clay Paky HY B-EYE K15, 19 x RGBW LED moving head with Kaleido FX and a pixel engine

manual.note: datasheet only; the standard K15 DMX chart was NOT obtained (claypaky.it links to e-assist.tech, login; two manual hosts refused automated reading). The K15 AQUA chart is a different variant and is NOT copied in as this lamp

modes.name: 22ch
modes.label: Basic (22 per datasheet)
modes.note: From the datasheet's '22/36/57/76 DMX channels' only. CHANNEL LIST OWED: the standard K15 DMX chart sits behind the maker's login (claypaky.it -> e-assist.tech). 22 is probably Standard + Freq (the AQUA sheet counts Standard 21 / Standard Freq 22): an inference, not read.

modes.name: 36ch
modes.label: Shape (36 per datasheet)
modes.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Probably Shape + Freq (AQUA: Shape 35 / Shape Freq 36): an inference, not read.

modes.name: 57ch
modes.label: Pixel RGB
modes.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Pixel engine, own address (user menu 02.2022); pixels only, no pan / tilt / zoom - inferred from the menu structure and the K10 manual, not read for the K15.

modes.name: 76ch
modes.label: Pixel RGBW
modes.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Pixel engine RGBW, 19 x 4; pixels only (inferred, as above).

modes.name: 112ch
modes.label: Shape + Pixel RGBW
modes.note: The combined mode the Platina plan uses: the 36-channel basic list followed by the 76-channel pixel list = 112, two engines addressed side by side (pixel address = basic address + 36). LIST OWED with the two it is made of.

power_w.note: datasheet p1 '700 VA at 230 V' - VA, not W; kept as published

size_mm.order: W x D x H, head upright (home)
size_mm.note: manual p10 drawing: base 329 x 387, 391 across the yoke, 438 high with the head upright, 496 with the head horizontal, lens face 240, head 224 deep zoomed in / 264 zoomed out. The maker's product page (claypaky.it/products/hy-b-eye-k15, read 2026-11-12) gives the same base 329 x 387 and 496 mm. Which base side lies along the yoke is read from the drawing (387), not printed.
